purpose: Teach: 大笑い/ぱっと/ぺん/愛犬/老化/タメ/木製/無茶

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの話、家族で、大笑いしたよね、本当に、楽しかった、先週末。
lines.en: Mom, we all had such a good laugh at Grandpa's story last weekend, didn't we? It was really fun.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery with natural child enthusiasm. Quick pace, unguarded openness. Slight breathless quality like he's reliving the memory as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祭りの灯、ぱっと、つくと、本当に、わくわくするわよね、翔くん。
lines.en: Yes. When the festival lights come on all at once, it really does feel magical, doesn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, present tone with genuine interest in his memory. Gentle tempo. Attentive to him — the kind of listening that makes him want to keep talking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 動物園で、ぺんぎん、見たよ、ぼく、可愛かったよ、すごく、近くで、見れたんだ!
lines.en: We saw penguins at the zoo and they were so cute! I got to see them really close up!
lines.style: Excited, animated delivery with childlike wonder breaking through. Faster pace, bright attack on the memory. Small triumphant note on seeing them up close.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの愛犬、まだ、元気よね、本当に、長生きしてるわね、十五歳でしょ?
lines.en: Grandma's dog is still doing well, isn't she? Fifteen years old now — she's had such a long life.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone with a note of quiet admiration. Steady pace, warm. Speaking as much to herself as to him — the kind of thing a parent thinks out loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、老化、ちょっと、心配だね、ママ、最近、お祖父ちゃん、疲れやすそうだよね。
lines.en: I'm a little worried about Grandpa, Mom. He seems to get tired more easily lately, doesn't he?
lines.style: Soft, hesitant entry with genuine concern underneath. Quiet, careful — checking if it's okay to say out loud. Not alarmed, but noticing in that startlingly perceptive way he has.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達と、タメ口で、話すの、楽しいわよね、翔くん、お友達、増えて、よかったね。
lines.en: It's nice to talk casually with your friends, isn't it, Sho? I'm so glad you've made more friends.
lines.style: Warm affection with clear maternal pride. Unhurried, present. Speaking to him like his feelings and growth matter — because they do.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お家の、木製の椅子、ぼく、好きだよ、ママ、温かい感じが、するんだ、本当に。
lines.en: I really like the wooden chair at home, Mom. It feels warm, somehow. Really warm.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere delivery with a child's earnestness about small things that feel important. Soft pace. The kind of simple truth he's willing to share.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 無茶な遊び、しないようにね、翔くん、ママ、心配だからね、いつも、本当に。
lines.en: Don't play so recklessly, okay Sho? Mom worries about you. I always do, you know.
lines.style: Gentle firmness without sharpness — not lecturing but clearly meant. Warm undertone. The quiet weight of genuine worry in her voice, not performance.
